x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_SPOT: Allow reading spot orders and trades (no write).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRADE_SPOT: Allow placing and modifying spot orders and triggers, including reading spot orders and trades. Cancellation and pausing remain available as safety actions.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.DENYLISTED_ADDRESS: The destination is blocked by Polyester's user-safety denylist.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_ADDRESS: The address is not valid for the selected destination chain.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.POLYESTER_SMART_ACCOUNT: The destination is a Polyester smart account and cannot be used for an external-chain withdraw.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TOKEN_CONTRACT: The destination is a token contract and cannot receive withdrawals.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.UNSUPPORTED_CHAIN: The selected destination chain is not supported for withdraws.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.VALID: The destination is valid and may be used for a withdraw.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.EXTERNAL_ADDRESS: External wallet or chain address. The address is lifecycle-derived and may be empty until ledger-to-lifecycle correlation is projected.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FEE_ACCOUNT: Fee ledger side, for example spot or perp trading fees.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PRIVATE_COUNTERPARTY: Private off-chain counterparty that must not be identified to the caller. account_id and address are intentionally omitted.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SYSTEM_ACCOUNT: System, operator, clearing, or other non-user side.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ENABLED: New orders and cancellations are accepted.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.POST_ONLY: New orders must use a post-only execution variant.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REDUCE_ONLY: New spot orders are blocked by reduce-only policy.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.1h: 1 hour sparkline. Typically returns up to 60 points (1-minute buckets).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.1mo: 1 month sparkline. Typically returns up to 180 points (4-hour buckets).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.1w: 1 week sparkline. Typically returns up to 168 points (1-hour buckets).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.24h: 24 hour sparkline. Typically returns up to 96 points (15-minute buckets).

x-poly-enum-descriptions.NOT_CONFIGURED: No leg configured on the parent order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.RUNNING: Trigger is executing runtime work (for example multi-step workflows).

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACCEPTED: The cancellation request was accepted for processing.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.PARTIALLY_ADMITTED: Some requested replacements were admitted and others were rejected.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ADMITTED: The replacement was admitted and handed to execution.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REJECTED: The replacement was rejected before execution handoff.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ARMED: The dead-man switch is armed or refreshed.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.DRY_RUN: The request only counted matching orders and submitted no cancellations.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SUBMITTED: Matching cancellation requests were submitted for processing.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACCEPTED: The cancellation request was accepted for processing.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACCOUNT_UNKNOWN: Referenced account could not be resolved by the trading service.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.API_KEY_MARKET_DENY: API key policy does not allow trading this market, even though the sub-account policy does.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.API_KEY_POLICY_REQUIRED: API key must have an attached policy before it can be used for trading.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.API_KEY_ROOT_SCOPE_ONLY: API key is scoped to the master/root account and cannot trade on sub-accounts.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.API_KEY_SPOT_READ_DENY: API key policy does not allow reading spot data.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.API_KEY_SUBACCOUNT_MISMATCH: API key is scoped to a different sub-account than the one requested.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.API_KEY_SUB_SCOPE_ONLY: API key is scoped to a specific sub-account and cannot trade on the master/root account.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.API_KEY_UNKNOWN: API key referenced in the request could not be resolved by the Orders service.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.BAD_PRICE: Price is invalid for the requested order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.BAD_QTY: Quantity is invalid for the requested order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.BAD_REQUEST: Request could not be parsed or was structurally invalid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.BATCH_TOO_LARGE: Batch size exceeds the maximum allowed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CANCEL_REQUEST_EXPIRED: The cancel request exceeded its bounded internal replay window.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CONFLICT_DUPLICATE_CLIENT_ORDER_ID: Client order ID is already in use for a different active order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CONFLICT_DUPLICATE_CLIENT_TRIGGER_ID: Duplicate client trigger ID was reused with a different trigger payload.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CONFLICT_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE: Idempotency key was reused with a different payload.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.EMPTY_BOOK: Market order could not execute due to empty book.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FEE_ASSET_NOT_ALLOWED: Requested fee asset is not allowed for this order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FOK_INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY: FOK order rejected due to insufficient immediate liquidity.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS: Account does not have enough available balance for the order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INTERNAL_ERROR: Order processing failed because of an unexpected error.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MARKET_PRICE_UNAVAILABLE: MARKET BUY cannot be reserved because no reference/top-of-book price is available.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MAX_QUOTE_DEBIT_TOO_SMALL: The all-in quote budget cannot resolve one valid step-aligned base quantity.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MAX_SLIPPAGE_INVALID: Trailing-stop max slippage (ticks or bps) is invalid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MIN_NOTIONAL: Order notional is below the pair minimum.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MIN_QTY: Quantity is below the pair minimum quantity (base units).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MODIFICATION_REQUIRES_REPLACE: Modify request in AMEND_ONLY mode requires replace semantics.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.NOT_FOUND: Requested order or resource was not found.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ORDER_ALREADY_TERMINAL: Client order ID points to an order that already reached terminal state.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ORDER_UNKNOWN: Referenced order could not be resolved.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.OVERLOADED: This edge is at its bounded concurrent BatchReplace admission capacity.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAIR_DELISTED: Pair was delisted and is no longer tradable.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAIR_DISABLED: Pair is disabled and does not accept orders.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAIR_NOT_LISTED_YET: Pair exists but is not listed yet.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAIR_POST_ONLY: Pair is in post-only mode and requires post_only=true.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAIR_REDUCE_ONLY: Pair is in reduce-only mode and does not accept new spot orders.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PERMISSION_DENIED: Caller is authenticated but not allowed to perform this action.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.POLICY_MARKET_DENY: Sub-account policy prevented trading on this market (e.g. pair mask).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.POLICY_MAX_NOTIONAL: Sub-account policy max order notional exceeded.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.POLICY_MAX_OPEN_ORDERS: Sub-account policy maximum number of open orders has been reached.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.POLICY_SPOT_READ_DENY: Sub-account policy does not allow reading spot data.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.POLICY_SPOT_TRADE_DENY: Sub-account policy does not allow spot trading (action mask).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.POLICY_TRADING_HALTED: Trading has been globally halted for this sub-account.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.POST_ONLY_CROSS: Post-only order would cross the book.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.POST_ONLY_LIMIT_ONLY: Post-only is only valid for LIMIT orders.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PRICE_BAND_VIOLATION: Price band guard rejected the order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PRICE_TICK_SIZE: Price must align with the pair tick size (LIMIT orders).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.QTY_STEP_SIZE: Quantity does not align with the pair step size.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The account exhausted its current order-admission quota.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.STALE_QUOTE: Client reference price is stale compared to server-side BBO/drift policy.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SUBACCOUNT_INACTIVE: Sub-account is present but not in an active state (disabled, deleted, etc.).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SUBACCOUNT_READ_FORBIDDEN: Caller has a sub-account role that does not allow reading spot data.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRAILING_DISTANCE_INVALID: Trailing stop distance must be positive.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRIGGER_CANCEL_REJECTED: Trigger cannot be canceled in current state.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRIGGER_NOT_MODIFIABLE: Trigger type/state does not support requested lifecycle operation.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRIGGER_PRICE_INVALID: Trigger-specific error codes (40-49 range). Trigger price is invalid (e.g., TP below current price for long).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRIGGER_PRICE_SOURCE_UNSUPPORTED: Trigger price source not supported (e.g., INDEX_PRICE before it's available).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRIGGER_STATUS_INVALID: Trigger status does not allow requested lifecycle operation.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.VALIDATION_ERROR: Request failed structural or cross-field validation.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.BASE: BUY-only option: fees are deducted from the received base asset.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.QUOTE: Fees are charged in the quote asset. SELL fees always use quote asset.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.AMENDED: Existing order was amended in place.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REPLACED: Existing order was canceled and replaced with a new order.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.AMEND_ONLY: In-place amend only; reject if patch requires replace semantics.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.AMEND_OR_REPLACE: Try in-place amend first; if patch cannot be amended, fall back to replace.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ATTACHED_RISK: Child generated by attached TP/SL/Trailing risk on a parent order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.STANDALONE_TRIGGER: Child generated by a standalone trigger (STOP/TWAP/LADDER...).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SYSTEM: System-managed automation, such as liquidation or account-protection actions.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.PENDING: Accepted and submitted for execution, but not yet confirmed as working.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PENDING_CANCEL: Cancel requested; may still be working until cancel is confirmed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REJECTED: Rejected and never entered the working state.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.WORKING: Accepted and actively working (resting and/or matching).

x-poly-enum-descriptions.LADDER: Order was generated by a ladder execution trigger.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.STOP_LOSS: Order was generated by a stop-loss trigger.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TAKE_PROFIT: Order was generated by a take-profit trigger.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRAILING_STOP: Order was generated by a trailing-stop trigger.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TWAP: Order was generated by a time-weighted execution trigger.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.LIMIT: Limit order with an explicit price.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MARKET: Market order executed against available liquidity.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.EXPIRE_BOTH: Cancel both maker and taker orders on self-trade.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.EXPIRE_MAKER: Cancel the resting maker order on self-trade.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.EXPIRE_TAKER: Cancel the incoming taker order on self-trade.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.BUY: Buy base asset using quote asset.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SELL: Sell base asset for quote asset.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ABOVE: Fire when price >= trigger_price (e.g., take-profit for long, stop-loss for short).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.BELOW: Fire when price <= trigger_price (e.g., stop-loss for long, take-profit for short).

x-poly-enum-descriptions.INDEX_PRICE: Index price aggregated from external exchanges (future).

x-poly-enum-descriptions.AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE: The required rate-limit authority could not make a safe decision.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.QUOTA_EXCEEDED: The active weighted quota did not have enough capacity.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACCOUNT: The authenticated account owns the capacity.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.API_KEY: The authenticated API key owns the capacity.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.AUTH_SUBJECT: A privacy-preserving normalized public authentication subject owns capacity.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CLIENT_IP: The normalized client network address owns the capacity.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CONNECTION: The active realtime connection owns the capacity.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REGION: The serving region owns the capacity.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SERVICE: The calling service owns the capacity.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SUBACCOUNT: The selected subaccount owns the capacity.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SYMBOL: The trading or market-data symbol owns the capacity.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACCOUNT_ADMIN: General account and subaccount administration operations.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACCOUNT_SECURITY: MFA, recovery, API-key, policy, and security-control mutations.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DEPOSIT_CREATE: Deposit-address creation that may call an upstream provider.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PUBLIC_READ: Public market-data and realtime read operations.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRADING_CANCEL: Trading order and trigger cancellation operations.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRADING_PLACE: Trading order and trigger placement operations.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.CONTINUOUS: Capacity refills continuously over the configured policy period.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FIXED_WINDOW: Capacity resets at fixed window boundaries.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ROLLING_WINDOW: Capacity is measured over a rolling time window.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACCEPTED: The transfer request was accepted and has a durable transfer identifier.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FAILED: The transfer request failed terminally before durable acceptance.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REJECTED: The transfer request was rejected before durable acceptance.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.INTERNAL_ERROR: An internal invariant or processing failure canceled the trigger.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MISSING_REASON_CODE: The terminal state did not contain a cancellation reason.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PARENT_CANCELED_NO_FILL: The parent order ended without a fill, so its attached trigger was canceled.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.USER_REQUEST: The user explicitly canceled the trigger.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.FAILED: Trigger became terminal after its next child order could not be admitted.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FIRED: Trigger fired and may have created a child order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.UPDATED: Trigger configuration or lifecycle state was updated.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACCOUNT_UNKNOWN: The account associated with the trigger was not recognized.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CONFLICT_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE: An idempotency key was reused with different request details.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DUPLICATE_CLIENT_ID: The child order reused a client order ID that was already accepted.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.EMPTY_BOOK: The order book had no liquidity available for the child order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ENGINE_BUSY: The market could not accept the child order at that time.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FEE_ASSET_NOT_ALLOWED: The selected fee asset was not permitted for the child order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FEE_CEILING_EXCEEDED: The applicable fee rate exceeded the maximum accepted by the trigger.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FOK_INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY: The order book could not fill the entire fill-or-kill child order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS: The account did not have enough available funds for the child order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INTERNAL_ERROR: An internal invariant or processing failure caused the trigger to fail.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_SIZING: The child order sizing fields did not form a valid sizing request.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MARKET_CAP_VIOLATION: The market child order exceeded the configured execution cap.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MARKET_HALTED: Trading was halted for the requested market.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MARKET_PRICE_UNAVAILABLE: A current market price was unavailable for sizing or validation.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MAX_QUOTE_DEBIT_TOO_SMALL: The maximum quote debit could not fund the minimum valid child order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MIN_NOTIONAL: The child order value was below the pair's minimum notional.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MIN_QUANTITY: The child order quantity was below the pair's minimum quantity.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MISSING_REASON_CODE: The terminal state did not contain a failure reason.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MODIFICATION_REQUIRES_REPLACE: The requested modification required replacing the trigger instead.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ORDER_ALREADY_TERMINAL: The referenced order had already reached a terminal state.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ORDER_UNKNOWN: An order referenced by the trigger was not found.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAIR_DISABLED: The trading pair was not accepting new orders.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.POLICY_MARKET_DENY: Account policy did not permit trading in this market.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.POLICY_MAX_NOTIONAL: The child order would have exceeded the policy notional limit.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.POLICY_MAX_OPEN_ORDERS: The child order would have exceeded the policy open-order limit.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.POLICY_SPOT_TRADE_DENY: Account policy did not permit spot trading.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.POST_ONLY_CROSS: The post-only child order would have immediately taken liquidity.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PRICE_BAND_VIOLATION: The child order price was outside the allowed market price band.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.RATE_LIMITED: The request exceeded an applicable rate limit.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REDUCE_ONLY_BLOCKED: The reduce-only child order would not have reduced the position.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.RISK_LIMIT: The child order would have exceeded an account risk limit.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.STALE_QUOTE: The quote used to size or validate the child order was no longer current.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.STEP_SIZE: The child order quantity was not aligned to the pair's step size.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TICK_SIZE: The child order price was not aligned to the pair's tick size.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRAILING_DISTANCE_INVALID: The configured trailing distance was invalid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRIGGER_PRICE_INVALID: The configured trigger price was invalid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRIGGER_PRICE_SOURCE_UNSUPPORTED: The selected trigger price source was not supported.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.UNKNOWN_SYMBOL: The requested trading pair was not recognized.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ARMED: Trigger admitted and actively evaluating conditions.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.COMPLETED: Trigger completed successfully (all child orders placed/filled).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CREATED: Trigger was created and is pending activation.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FAILED: Trigger failed (for example, reservation failure, child order rejection).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAUSED: Trigger is paused (user-initiated, can be resumed).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.RUNNING: Trigger is actively executing (for example, TWAP slices in progress).

x-poly-enum-descriptions.LADDER: Ladder/Scaled: Multiple orders placed across a price range.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.STOP_LOSS: Stop-loss: fires when the price crosses a threshold.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TAKE_PROFIT: Take-profit: fires when the price crosses a threshold.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRAILING_STOP: Trailing stop: dynamic stop that trails price by a distance.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TWAP: TWAP: Time-Weighted Average Price execution over a duration.
